title: Qatil Nu Ali Nay Shabbir Da Sadqa Paani
body:
Qatil Nu Ali Nay Shabbir Da Sadqa Paani Si Pilaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sadqa-e-Zainab Si Rasiyan Nal Bajiyan Bawan Nu Khulay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab Ay Soch Kay Haye Hairaan Si Bari
Main Tay Na Bazaran Vich Na Aaye Kadi
Fair Kyon Babay Nay Kufay Shehar Da Menu
Bazaar Vakhya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Valaan Nu Khol Kay Haye Dhiyaan Nay Rondiyan
Babay Di Laash Tay Baite Kay Vain Pondiyan
Aagaye Ay Yateemi Uth Gaya Ay Saday Sir Ton
Aj Babay Da Saaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Duniya Ton Jandiyan Haye Sub Nu Bula Laya
Zainab Day Hath Ch Ghazi Da Ay Keh Ke Si Khat Daya
Bhena Day Parday Da Aj Ton Ghazi Tainu
Zamin Main Banaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Manzar Ajeeb Si Haye Saqlain Kufay Da
Uthiya Janaza Yasrab Day Shah Da Is Tarah
Shaam Waliyan Royan Karbala Dan Shaheedan
Taboot Uthaya.
